verdict.rationale: Trilegal's Private Equity and Corporate/M&A pages show clear cross-border venture work — advising international investors (Blackstone, KKR, Carlyle, Prosus) on fund formation, PE deployment and exits, plus inbound/outbound M&A for 'domestic and international investors' — but the firm's offices are India-only with no overseas presence, and there is no explicit mention of flip/redomiciliation structuring or multi-jurisdiction financing mechanics. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of flip/redomiciliation transactions, multi-jurisdiction financing deal specifics, and any overseas office/affiliate network for true cross-border reach.
